title: Germinating pollen grain
back: Tube emerges through a germ pore; tube nucleus at the tip, two male gametes behind it.

title: Pollen germination procedure
back: 15–30 minutes in a moist chamber; low power first, then high power.

title: Germination medium
legend: B = boric acid: helps tube growth

title: Percentage germination
back: Count several fields and use the totals.

title: Exine vs germ pore
back: The tube can grow out only where sporopollenin is absent: the germ pore.

title: Viva: why a moist chamber?
back: If the drop dries, the sugar concentration rises and germination stops.

title: Pollen germination precautions
back: Also: dust lightly; focus under low power first.

title: Sweet Boy
back: Sucrose feeds the pollen; boric acid boosts tube growth.

title: Two to go
back: Over 60% of angiosperms: vegetative + generative cell; the generative cell later gives two male gametes.
